correctness.rationale: For g>0 and sin(phi) nonzero, A+A†=-2gP0 implies all eigenvalues are strictly in the left half-plane: an imaginary-axis eigenvector would have no trap amplitude, force v2=±v1, and require e^{i phi}=±1. The exact Hermitian Q in RESULT.md satisfies A†Q+QA=-I using s²+c²=1. Thus Q11 is the convergent no-jump survival integral. At sin(phi)=0 the initial site overlaps a stationary dark mode and the mean is infinite. Strict one-dimensional sign analysis of d/ds[g/(2s²)+1/(2s)] gives optimal s=-min(2g,1), with exact optimizer multiplicity; differentiation in g gives the unique sharp global g=sqrt(3) and value sqrt(3)-1/2. All boundaries and quantifiers are covered.
